does: Rolls a saving throw of an ability against a difficulty through the roll against a difficulty and marks the hit when the save succeeds.

evidence.says: The ability is 1 to 6, the stream comes from the roll stream provider called with the condition's context, and bit 0x100 of the hit's flags is set on success

A target's save against Sacred Flame and Hold Person asks the roll against a difficulty from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x10707A0 inside this function: on the caster's PlayerSpell stream when the player casts, on the Generic stream for a status's repeating save and for an NPC's spell outside a fight; the roller named is the target

questions.ask: A spell that asks its target for a save, watched: which stream it draws from
